title: the FIRST summer-trained run — de-toy H_1187: does a REAL TRAINED numpy-MLP next-byte surprise reader (not a count n-gram) reproduce the saccadic-reading result (beat a uniform metronome scan on real-text stage-decode, temporally)?

frozen_falsifier.Kstar: argmax over cap ladder (4, 6, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32, 48, 64) of d_surprise_vs_metro (text's own cap)
frozen_falsifier.F1: d_surprise_vs_metro(K*) >= 0.5 (trained-reader saccadic reading beats uniform scan)
frozen_falsifier.F2: (d_real - d_shuf) >= 0.5 at K* (advantage destroyed by time-shuffle = temporal)
frozen_falsifier.SUPPORTED: F1 and F2 (SACCADIC-READING-HOLDS-AT-LESS-TOY-SCALE — de-toys H_1187 one rung)
frozen_falsifier.metric: STAGE-DECODE accuracy (p7, NOT the model's loss/perplexity)

comparison_to_h1187: H_1192 (TRAINED MLP): K*=4, d_real=+1.168, drop=+0.621  vs  H_1187 (COUNT n-gram): K*=24, d_real=+1.015, drop=+0.512. Result SURVIVES the de-toy — the saccadic-reading advantage reproduces on a genuine gradient-trained predictor.
ruling: SUPPORTED (SACCADIC-READING-HOLDS-AT-LESS-TOY-SCALE): a REAL TRAINED numpy-MLP surprise reader (SGD-learned weights, val_ce=2.83 < unigram 5.91 < uniform 8.0 bits/byte) reproduces H_1187's saccadic-reading result at the text's own cap K*=4: it BEATS a uniform metronome scan (F1 d_real=+1.17>=0.5) AND that advantage is TEMPORAL — destroyed by a time-shuffle (F2 drop=+0.62>=0.5). The H_1187 finding was NOT a count-table artifact: surprise-driven saccadic reading de-toys ONE rung to a genuine gradient-trained predictor. (Model loss is NOT the verdict; stage-decode is.)
reading_answer: YES, AND it de-toys — a GENUINELY TRAINED model's surprise (not a count table) still drives saccadic reading that beats a uniform scan AND is temporally grounded. The H_1187 finding is robust to a real gradient-trained predictor one rung up.
scope: TOY-ISH ($0 CPU numpy, 10 seeds) but a GENUINE TRAINED model — a one-hidden-layer MLP next-byte predictor (SGD 8 epochs, k=4 one-hot ctx, hid=64) on ONE corpus, a real step UP from H_1187's order-4 COUNT n-gram. Reuses the H_1163 grow_arm METRONOME + stage_decode + cohen_d + make_text_stream and H_1187 grow_arm_surprise + CAP_LADDER + time-shuffle VERBATIM; the ONLY swap is the surprise SOURCE (count-table -> trained MLP). NOT a production LLM; real-LLM surprise + real human reading-time/eye-tracking + scale UNVERIFIED (a_scale_honest_scope, a_toy_scale_recheck). The reader's SGD is a separate predictor; the mitosis GROWTH arm stays Lane-M gradient-free (a_lane_akida_gpu_split). Ran on the SUMMER pool host (CPU linux, python3.12 + numpy).
